course.learningOutcomes: Understand and apply the mathematical concept in aircraft maintenance work, able to calculate the basic equation formular, Algebra and Geometry, Have a good attitude and patience with work.
course.objectives:
Course Objectives
1. Be able to understand Mathematics in such as the contents of Arithmetical terms and signs, Algebra and Geometry.
2. Be able to describe the formular or equation of Mathematics, Algebra and Geometry.
3. Have a good attitude to work neatly, be patience with work, a habit of working carefully and safety.
4. Be able to calculate the Mathematics, Algebra and Geometry.
course.competencies:
1. Describe the equation of Mathematics, Algebra and Geometry are correct.
2. Calculate the Mathematics, Algebra and Geometry are correct.
3. Appling the formular or equation of Mathematics, Algebra and Geometry are correct.
course.description: To study Arithmetic that should know about Arithmetical terms and signs, ratio and proportion and can calculate in averages and percentages. There is also Algebra that is evaluating simple algebraic expressions, Linear equations and their solutions. And the last one is Geometry that consist of Simple geometrical constructions and simple trigonometry.
